run_degradation_bsrgan_variant: run the BSRGAN variant degradation model on an image with a given scale factor
run_degradation_bsrgan: run the BSRGAN degradation model to produce low-quality and high-quality image patches
create_anisotropic_Gaussian_kernel: create an anisotropic Gaussian kernel with configurable size, rotation angle, and eigenvalue scaling
generate_gen_kernel: generate a random Gaussian kernel with configurable size, scale factor, and variance range
add_Gaussian_noise: add Gaussian noise to an image with configurable noise level range
